name: Netflix

fastest.text: Open netflix.com/cancelplan in a browser. You can't cancel inside the Netflix app.

note: If you pay through Google Play, Roku or your TV provider, cancel there instead.

faq.q: Do I keep watching after I cancel?
faq.a: Yes, until the end of your current billing period.
Netflix has no pause in the US. If you come back within 10 months, your profiles and history are still there.
